name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Rapid pace of interceptor and precision-guided weapons use worries Trump admin.
changes.summary: The U.S. defense industrial base isn't equipped to produce missiles rapidly enough to replenish munitions used in the war with Iran, or transferred for use to Central Command.

changes.title: U.S. attorney who served for less than an hour suing Trump administration over firing
changes.summary: A U.S. attorney who served for less than an hour is suing the Trump administration over his firing. Roger Rogoff is asking a federal court to reinstate him as U.S. Attorney for the Western District of Washington. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson breaks down the legal questions in this case.

changes.title: Trump fires U.S. attorney in Washington on heels of court appointment
changes.summary: Judges on the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington had appointed Roger Rogoff as U.S. attorney in Seattle. But he was fired shortly after.

changes.title: International PhD students to face strict limits on time in the US
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 23 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02280-3 Trump administration takes action to address ‘forever students’.

changes.title: Laura Loomer meets with Ukraine's Zelenskyy after her major reversal on the war
changes.summary: Laura Loomer, an ardent ally of President Donald Trump with a reputation for incendiary social media commentary, sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Thursday after a dramatic turnaround on the war that could have political reverberations back in Washington.

changes.title: Rubio says U.S. is ready to help end war in Ukraine but no quick deal ahead
changes.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who met with his Russian counterpart Sergey Lavrov, said that President Trump was committed to the work "if conditions and factors have changed to make that possible." (Image credit: BRENDAN SMIALOWSKI).

changes.title: Rob Bonta on blocking the Paramount merger, CNN concerns and Trump’s DOJ
changes.summary: Rob Bonta on blocking the Paramount merger, CNN concerns and Trump’s DOJ lead image.

changes.title: Trump’s Global Tariffs: What’s the Latest on the Trade War
changes.summary: The president has unveiled a complicated system to forge ahead with his trade war, after the Supreme Court stuck down his original levies.

changes.title: Trump imposes new tariffs on dozens of countries, citing forced labor concerns
changes.summary: The Trump administration will impose tariffs of up to 12.5% on goods from 60 U.S. trading partners accused of failing to crack down on forced labor, extending the administration's tariffs on much of the world.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: U.S.-Iran strikes escalate, affecting global energy markets, Trump imposes double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries, Vigil held in Madison, Wisconsin, for man killed by police.
